notablePrerequisites:
Lands able to tap for {1}{U}.
You control a white permanent.
description:
Cast View from Above targeting Great Whale.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters, untapping seven lands you control.
View from Above resolves, returning to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other permanents you control in step 1, gaining infinite copies of those permanents in step 2.
